name: IUATesting
title: IUA: TestPlans and Gherkin for the IUA actors
description: A demonstration IG that declares, as TestPlan resources and Gherkin feature files, the conformance tests for the three actors of IHE ITI Internet User Authorization (IUA), Revision 2.5: Authorization Client, Authorization Server and Resource Server. IUA publishes no FHIR package, so every test case is traceable instead to a quoted requirement in the supplement's narrative or to the OAuth 2.1 clause it rests on.
disclaimer: This is not an approved IHE test specification, and these tests have not been executed against any implementation.

spec.title: IHE ITI Internet User Authorization (IUA), Revision 2.5

specDependencyNote: IUA is published as a narrative supplement carrying both volumes, not as a FHIR implementation guide. There is no ihe.iti.iua package on the registry, so there is nothing for the publisher to resolve against: the actors below are named in prose rather than by ActorDefinition canonical, and every requirement is quoted from the supplement in the test it justifies
planIntro: One test plan per actor of [IHE ITI Internet User Authorization (IUA), Revision 2.5](https://profiles.ihe.net/ITI/IUA/). IUA states its obligations in prose, so each test names the sentence or the OAuth 2.1 clause it tests rather than an element obligation:
artifactsSummary: The three TestPlan resources, one per actor, and the Gherkin scripts they name.

actors.title: Authorization Server
actors.scopeDescription: The IUA Authorization Server — the system which issues access tokens on transaction Get Access Token [ITI-71], and which introspects them on Introspect Token [ITI-102] when it claims the Token Introspection Option — is the system under test.
actors.summary: the server issues tokens that carry the claims the profile requires, and refuses every malformed or unauthorised request in the way OAuth 2.1 prescribes

actors.title: Resource Server
actors.scopeDescription: The IUA Resource Server — the system which polices the access token on transaction Incorporate Access Token [ITI-72] before serving a protected resource — is the system under test.
actors.summary: the server serves a request carrying a valid token and refuses every case the profile says it must: expired, wrong audience, insufficient scope, malformed or absent

actors.title: Authorization Client
actors.scopeDescription: The IUA Authorization Client — the system which obtains an access token on Get Access Token [ITI-71] and presents it on Incorporate Access Token [ITI-72] — is the system under test. For this actor the test bed plays both the Authorization Server and the Resource Server and waits to be called.
actors.summary: the client asks for a token correctly, presents the token it was issued, does not leak it to a server outside its audience, and obtains a fresh one after a refusal
